title: DDoS-AI: High-Throughput Cascading Dual-Tier Architecture for Real-Time DDoS Detection and Autonomous Mitigation in Software-Defined Networks
description: An advanced network security and artificial intelligence platform designed to detect, classify, and mitigate volumetric, reflection, application-layer, and zero-day DDoS attacks across Software-Defined Networks (SDN) and cloud environments.
